# free-courses.top

> > A curated directory of free YouTube courses spanning design, engineering, analytics, and professional development.

free-courses.top aggregates high-quality free educational content from platforms like YouTube, NPTEL, and industry-leading educators. The site covers practical skills in design software (Photoshop, AutoCAD), engineering disciplines (civil, mechanical, software), analytics, and research methodologies.

## Key Topics

- Photoshop
- AutoCAD
- Software Engineering
- Google Analytics 4
- Graphic Design
- CAD Training
- Civil Engineering
- Image Editing
- NPTEL
- Manufacturing Quality Control
- Medical Imaging
- Qualitative Research
- Design Fundamentals
- YouTube Education
- Free Courses

## Design & Image Editing

- [Photoshop for Beginners](https://free-courses.top/course/photoshop-for-beginners-free-course): Beginner's guide to Adobe Photoshop image editing, layers, retouching, and design fundamentals.
- [Graphic Design Tutorials](https://free-courses.top/course/graphic-design-tutorials): Fundamental graphic design and Photoshop tools tutorial series for beginners.

## Engineering & CAD

- [AutoCAD Training for Engineers](https://free-courses.top/course/autocad-training-for-beginners-for-mechanical-civil-architect-interior-and-electrical-engineers): AutoCAD 2D training for mechanical, civil, architectural, and electrical engineers.
- [Introduction to AutoCAD](https://free-courses.top/course/introduction-to-autocad): AutoCAD fundamentals, GIS integration, geospatial data, and georeferencing techniques.
- [Building Materials and Construction](https://free-courses.top/course/civil-building-materials-and-construction): Construction materials science covering concrete, steel, masonry, and durability.

## Software Development & Engineering

- [Software Engineering](https://free-courses.top/course/software-engineering-by-prof-rajib-mall): Software engineering principles, SDLC models, design, testing, and development methodologies.

## Analytics & Data

- [Google Analytics 4 Tutorials](https://free-courses.top/course/google-analytics-4-tutorials): Comprehensive Google Analytics 4 setup, event tracking, and web analytics implementation guide.

## Manufacturing & Quality Control

- [Inspection and Quality Control in Manufacturing](https://free-courses.top/course/inspection-and-quality-control-in-manufacturing): Manufacturing quality control techniques covering inspection, testing, and product integrity.

## Healthcare & Research

- [Introduction to Radiology](https://free-courses.top/course/lecture-series-on-introduction-to-radiology): Medical imaging techniques: radiography, CT, ultrasound, and MRI fundamentals.
- [Fundamentals of Qualitative Research Methods](https://free-courses.top/course/fundamentals-of-qualitative-research-methods): Qualitative research methods, interviews, focus groups, and data analysis techniques.

## Course Directory

- [Youtube courses](https://free-courses.top): Homepage featuring free YouTube courses across design, engineering, and tech topics.
